title: The Aftermath of the fourth floor walk-up
author: Jonah Iversen
blurb: Xanthe Kavanagh, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
